description: HIPAA compliance overlay — PHI audit trail, field-level AES-256-GCM helpers, role-based minimum-necessary middleware, BAA acknowledgment surface. Composes onto fullstack-ts / api-service / healthcare-hipaa-backend.

buildHints.whenToUse: Bolt HIPAA primitives (audit trail, field encryption, minimum-necessary middleware) onto an existing healthcare backend. Not a standalone application.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm validate` — confirms required files and key exports are present.
Run `pnpm build` — `tsc --noEmit` typechecks the full pack; zero errors expected.
Read `docs/HIPAA-controls.md` — each §164.312 control maps to one file in this pack.
Wire `withPhiAccess` from `src/phi-access.ts` onto every route that reads or writes PHI. The middleware MUST log BEFORE returning.
Wire `src/encryption.ts` helpers on every column storing SSN, DOB, MRN, or free-text clinical notes. AES-256-GCM with per-field IV; key must come from KMS/Vault, not env vars.
Replace `InMemoryAuditStore` with a DB-backed append-only store; add a TRIGGER or DENY UPDATE/DELETE on the audit table at the DB level (§164.312(c)(2)).
Emit `docs/BAA-template.md` as a signed doc before production PHI lands — gate the production API behind a signed-BAA state flag.
gotchas: Do NOT log PHI to stdout, structured JSON logs, or error traces. Every logger must run through a PHI-redaction filter — one slip violates §164.312(b).
Audit retention is ≥6 years per §164.316(b)(2)(i). Design the storage tier for it — don't plan to TTL old audit rows.
De-identification per §164.514 is NOT anonymization. Safe Harbor requires 18 specific identifier classes removed; Expert Determination needs a signed statistician's attestation.
Encryption at rest is 'addressable' not 'required' in §164.312 — but skipping it is almost always an audit failure. Always encrypt.
Minimum-necessary rule (§164.502(b)) means APIs must filter, not just the UI. A /patients endpoint that returns the full row and lets the caller discard fields is a violation.
architectureNotes: Pair with `healthcare-hipaa-backend` family for a full starter, or compose onto `fullstack-ts` / `api-service` / `python-api` for incremental adoption.

Audit table schema: id, actor_user_id, actor_role, action (enum), subject_table, subject_id, subject_fields_accessed[], at (timestamp), request_id, client_ip. Never include the PHI itself in the audit row — reference it by ID only.

TS source files are supplied by the family (src/encryption.ts, src/phi-access.ts, src/audit-log.ts, docs/, validate-hipaa-pack.mjs). This layer contributes package.json with a real name, tsconfig.json, and AGENTS.md.

placeholders.description: Reference middleware. Replace the stubbed route matchers with the product's real routes; keep the audit-before-return order.
BAA template. Legal MUST review + customize before use — it is not legal advice.
